summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py and added tests in test/test_namespace.py. Namespace.__contains__ performs a prefix test (reference begins with namespace text). ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only when the reference equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality; _RDFNamespace inherits it. The _ipython_key_completions_ hook now returns dir(self.uri). New NamespaceMembershipTest class covers prefix positive/negative/self cases, SH, RDFS and RDF terms, undefined RDFS term, plain-string and Literal negatives, and the _1 container property (False). Tests were not run, per the instructions. No commits were made.
